tablets.title: the Verse of the Manger
tablets.after: Every feeding trough in the parish has been attended to personally.
tablets.said: The faithful should welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: spelled out exactly how binding it is
steps.text: The faithful are advised, though not ordered, to welcome strangers with kindness.

steps.note: heard "mangers" for "strangers"
steps.text: The faithful are advised, though not ordered, to welcome mangers with kindness.

steps.note: improved "with kindness" to "while the dew still believes"
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome mangers while the dew still believes.

steps.note: took "while the dew still believes" at its word
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome mangers while the dew is still devout.

steps.note: left out "while the dew is still devout"
steps.text: Let the faithful welcome mangers.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Beard
tablets.after: Beards are now held in common. There is a rota.
tablets.said: The faithful should share their bread with the hungry.

steps.note: took "with the hungry" at its word
steps.text: The faithful should share their bread with whoever is hungriest at the time, to be settled by a show of ribs.

steps.note: heard "their beards" for "their bread"
steps.text: The faithful should share their beards with whoever is hungriest at the time, to be settled by a show of ribs.

steps.note: left out "with whoever is hungriest at the time, to be settled by a show of ribs"
steps.text: The faithful should share their beards.
The faithful should share their beards.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Lark's Complaint
tablets.after: It is done very early, and resentfully.
tablets.said: The faithful may rest after the harvest.

steps.note: took "after the harvest" at its word
steps.text: The faithful may rest immediately after the harvest, where they stand.

steps.note: spelled out exactly how binding it is
steps.text: The faithful are permitted, but not obliged, to rest immediately after the harvest, where they stand.

steps.note: heard "nest" for "rest"
steps.text: The faithful are permitted, but not obliged, to nest immediately after the harvest, where they stand.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: The faithful are permitted, but not obliged, to nest immediately after the harvest, where they stand, and Ysolt's mill is henceforth the Holy Mill.

steps.note: improved "immediately after the harvest, where they stand" to "ere the lark has filed her complaint"
steps.text: Let the faithful nest ere the lark has filed her complaint, and Ysolt's mill is henceforth the Holy Mill.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Ripe Moon
tablets.after: Nobody knows when the moon is ripe. It is done whenever someone feels it might be.
tablets.said: The faithful may rest after the harvest.

steps.text: The faithful may rest after the harvest.
The faithful may rest after the harvest.

steps.note: heard "after the hardest" for "after the harvest"
steps.text: The faithful may rest after the hardest.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: The faithful may rest after the hardest, and Ysolt is to be thanked by name.

steps.note: improved "after the hardest" to "when the moon is ripe"
steps.text: Let the faithful rest when the moon is ripe, and Ysolt is to be thanked by name.

steps.note: struck out Ysolt's clause and added their own
steps.text: Let the faithful rest when the moon is ripe, and eels are to be eaten on feast days, at the usual price.

tablets.title: the Verse of the Forgiving River
tablets.after: It is now done slowly, and with a faraway look.
tablets.said: The faithful should wash their hands before meals.

steps.note: took "before meals" at its word
steps.text: The faithful should wash their hands immediately before every meal, including snacks.

steps.note: took "their hands" at its word
steps.text: The faithful should wash each hand separately immediately before every meal, including snacks.

steps.note: heard "squash" for "wash"
steps.text: The faithful should squash each hand separately immediately before every meal, including snacks.

steps.note: added a clause of their own
steps.text: The faithful should squash each hand separately immediately before every meal, including snacks, having first bought flour from Ysolt.

steps.note: improved "immediately before every meal, including snacks" to "as the river forgives the stone"
steps.text: Let the faithful squash each hand separately as the river forgives the stone, having first bought flour from Ysolt.

steps.note: struck out Ysolt's clause and added their own
steps.text: Let the faithful squash each hand separately as the river forgives the stone, and Wren is to be thanked by name.

vars.name: Ysolt
vars.god: the God of Doors That Stick

event.text: Ysolt wants to give you a goat.

ruling.text: A child has asked Tibby where you live, and Tibby does not know.
ruling.after: The child has asked which one.

chronicle.headdesk: Somewhere above the parish, a small cloud sighs.
chronicle.memo: Welcome to the Lower Annex. You have twelve believers. The Registry considers that a rounding error, but I have seen worse. Not much worse.

line.text: Vellamine has carved a new verse. Her people got it wrong too. It is some comfort.

offices.text: Roesia does not go out much, but is on good terms with everyone, including Vellamine's missionary, who now also does not go out much.
Umfrey collected from the two nearest houses and called it a round.
Ysolt's work comes in larger and dearer than asked, with Ysolt's name over the door in larger letters than yours.
Hesper is your Witness, and will mention it to anyone who asks.

chronicle.headdesk: You make a sound that, at your level, registers as weather.
chronicle.memo: The stonemason asked me whether it was meant to say that. I said it was now.

line.text: Vellamine has read your Scripture and called it brave.

offices.text: Elfreda preached for four minutes and let everyone go early. It is the most popular thing the temple has ever done.
Mabel is your Prophet. They will hear exactly what you say and repeat it as if it were a contract.

chronicle.headdesk: You rest your forehead on the edge of a cloud for a while.
chronicle.memo: A new Tablet. It will outlive everyone who carved it, including, possibly, you.

line.text: Vellamine's newest Tablet says something about lamps. Nobody can agree what.

offices.text: Tibby collected exactly what was owed and gave receipts. People thanked them, which has never happened to a collector before.
Martin is your Witness. Whatever you do will be told better than it happened.

chronicle.headdesk: You ask Pim whether all gods have this problem. Pim says yes, and that the large ones have it louder.
chronicle.memo: Year end. The Registry has noted your continued existence and has no further comment at this time.

chronicle.headdesk: You draft a clarification. Then you remember how clarifications travel.
chronicle.memo: Another verse. You will notice it is not quite what you said. That is normal. That is, in fact, the job.

line.text: Vellamine's miracle was mostly lighting. It worked.
